issue.title: Break build cycle between OTel, logging and Flyway

body: @geoand, @mkouba. I think this issue is related with https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/44181, as well.

It's vaguely similar, but fixing either issue would **not** solve the other.

For this issue, I have opened https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/45136 but I don't really have a way to check if it does not break the Flyway extension in some obscure way

issue.title: OpenTelemetry Logs and Flyway build steps cycle

labels.name: triage/duplicate
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

issue.body:
### Describe the bug

The OpenTelemetry and Flyway extension have a cycle between build steps:

https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/42e6c329f61afbe05be80af95aa18a1ef2781d2e/extensions/opentelemetry/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/opentelemetry/deployment/logging/LogHandlerProcessor.java#L46-L53

https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/64f0108a59c6bf5129068cb0944c88deb204d96f/core/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/deployment/logging/LoggingResourceProcessor.java#L238-L260

https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/ef974032b8df45c29e9338ebf5ff7bcfdce68284/extensions/flyway/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/flyway/deployment/FlywayProcessor.java#L185-L195

### Expected behavior

_No response_

### Actual behavior

```
java.lang.RuntimeException: java.lang.RuntimeException: io.quarkus.builder.ChainBuildException: Cycle detected:
		   io.quarkus.arc.deployment.BeanArchiveProcessor#build produced class io.quarkus.arc.deployment.BeanArchiveIndexBuildItem
		to io.quarkus.smallrye.metrics.deployment.SmallRyeMetricsProcessor#transformBeanScope produced class io.quarkus.arc.deployment.AnnotationsTransformerBuildItem
		to io.quarkus.arc.deployment.ArcProcessor#initialize produced class io.quarkus.arc.deployment.ContextRegistrationPhaseBuildItem
		to io.quarkus.narayana.jta.deployment.NarayanaJtaProcessor#transactionContext produced class io.quarkus.arc.deployment.ContextRegistrationPhaseBuildItem$ContextConfiguratorBuildItem
		to io.quarkus.arc.deployment.ArcProcessor#registerBeans produced class io.quarkus.arc.deployment.TransformedAnnotationsBuildItem
		to io.quarkus.smallrye.reactivemessaging.deployment.WiringProcessor#extractComponents produced class io.quarkus.smallrye.reactivemessaging.deployment.items.ChannelBuildItem
		to io.quarkus.smallrye.reactivemessaging.deployment.WiringProcessor#detectOrphanChannels produced class io.quarkus.smallrye.reactivemessaging.deployment.items.OrphanChannelBuildItem
		to io.quarkus.smallrye.reactivemessaging.deployment.WiringProcessor#autoConfigureConnectorForOrphansAndProduceManagedChannels produced class io.quarkus.arc.deployment.ValidationPhaseBuildItem$ValidationErrorBuildItem
		to io.quarkus.arc.deployment.ArcProcessor#generateResources produced class io.quarkus.arc.deployment.ResourcesGeneratedPhaseBuildItem
		to io.quarkus.arc.deployment.ArcProcessor#initializeContainer produced class io.quarkus.arc.deployment.ArcContainerBuildItem
		to io.quarkus.arc.deployment.ArcProcessor#notifyBeanContainerListeners produced class io.quarkus.arc.deployment.PreBeanContainerBuildItem
		to io.quarkus.arc.deployment.ArcProcessor#signalBeanContainerReady produced class io.quarkus.arc.deployment.BeanContainerBuildItem
		to io.quarkus.opentelemetry.deployment.logging.LogHandlerProcessor#build produced class io.quarkus.deployment.builditem.LogHandlerBuildItem
		to io.quarkus.deployment.logging.LoggingResourceProcessor#setupLoggingRuntimeInit produced class io.quarkus.deployment.logging.LoggingSetupBuildItem
		to io.quarkus.flyway.deployment.FlywayProcessor#createBeans produced class io.quarkus.arc.deployment.AdditionalBeanBuildItem
		to io.quarkus.arc.deployment.BeanArchiveProcessor#build
```

### How to Reproduce?

https://github.com/radcortez/quarkus-playground/pull/268
